meaning: Normative shelf-sufficiency certification plus reproducible closure snapshot; not a complete-surviving-corpus, publication, or immutability claim.

criteria.basis: at least ninety percent of authorities have a registered body
at least sixty percent of Ancient body count despite more composite Medieval authority boundaries
more than one-and-a-half usable bodies per authority
clear majority of authorities are immediately usable
at least forty percent have work-level rather than metadata-only coverage ceilings
body verification, registry validation, index drift check, and focused tests all pass

sufficiency_standard.completeness_boundary: Shelf-level structural sufficiency only. Authority-level and body-level coverage ceilings remain controlling, and unresolved records remain explicit.

reopen_conditions: any Medieval source or body registry field changes
a Medieval body is admitted, corrected, removed, or changes hash
a missing or needs-review authority is resolved

unresolved_authorities.title: Great Domesday and Little Domesday
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Exceptional administrative state-capacity record. Boundary: Great and Little Domesday are distinct bodies; later summaries excluded.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Roster registration only; no body is admitted. Candidate research ceiling: principal-works. Principal unresolved gap: Confirm dataset license, transcription lineage, and treatment of abbreviations.

unresolved_authorities.title: Magna Carta, 1215 and reissues
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Legal transmission through repeated charter reissue and reinterpretation. Boundary: 1215 charter and later reissues must remain distinct witnesses.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: The admitted permissioned body is an English translation of the 1215 charter only. Its PDF-derived text layer contains minor spacing defects and remains needs-review. The Latin witness and the 1216, 1217, 1225, and 1297 reissues are absent.

unresolved_authorities.title: History of Prophets and Kings
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Indispensable universal and early Islamic chronicle. Boundary: History distinct from Qur'anic commentary; multi-volume sequence. One operator-permissioned OCR volume is admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: One Arabic edition volume is admitted with OCR review debt. The multi-volume History sequence is incomplete; no English equivalence or complete-work claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: al-Kamil fi al-tarikh / Complete History
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Universal chronicle spanning Crusades and early Mongol conquest. Boundary: Multi-volume universal chronicle; translated selections do not represent the whole.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Roster registration only; no body is admitted. Candidate research ceiling: principal-work. Principal unresolved gap: Rights-clear complete Arabic file and English gap.

unresolved_authorities.title: Muqaddimah
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Foundational causal theory of dynasty, taxation, labor, and historical method. Boundary: Muqaddimah is the introduction/first book of Kitab al-Ibar, not the full corpus. Two operator-permissioned Arabic OCR volumes are admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Two Arabic Quatremere volumes are admitted with OCR review debt, but the recovered sequence remains incomplete. No complete Muqaddimah, English body, or equivalence claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Siyasat-nama / Book of Government
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Core Persianate administrative manual. Boundary: Recension and late-chapter problem must remain visible. One operator-permissioned OCR volume is admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: One Schefer edition volume is admitted with OCR review debt. The recension and late-chapter boundary remain unresolved; no complete work or English equivalence claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Kitab al-Hind
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Exceptional translation and comparison across Persianate and Sanskritic knowledge. Boundary: Arabic India and Sachau translation bodies distinct. The operator-permissioned Sachau OCR is admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: The combined two-volume Sachau English edition is admitted with OCR review debt. No Arabic body, cross-language equivalence, or complete al-Biruni corpus claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Kutadgu Bilig
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Required Turkic mirror-for-princes tradition. Boundary: Kutadgu Bilig manuscript tradition; recensions/witnesses separate.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Roster registration only; no body is admitted. Candidate research ceiling: principal-work. Principal unresolved gap: Institutional original-language edition and reusable English.

unresolved_authorities.title: Safarnama
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Persian travel and Ismaili network observation. Boundary: Safarnama only; philosophical and poetic works separate. Operator-permissioned regional extracts are admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: English regional extracts are admitted with OCR review debt. No complete Safarnama, Persian body, cross-language equivalence, or complete Nasir Khusraw corpus claim.

unresolved_authorities.authority: Rashid al-Din Hamadani and Ilkhanid compilation atelier
unresolved_authorities.title: Jami al-tawarikh / Compendium of Chronicles
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Ilkhanid world history and administrative knowledge production. Boundary: Multi-part atelier compilation with Persian/Arabic witnesses and illustrated manuscripts.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Roster registration only; no body is admitted. Candidate research ceiling: selected-works. Principal unresolved gap: Edition/witness selection and lawful complete translation.

unresolved_authorities.title: Rajatarangini
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Essential Sanskrit historiography and Kashmir political memory. Boundary: Kalhana's eight books only; later Kashmir continuations separate. Two operator-permissioned Stein OCR volumes are admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Both Stein edition volumes are admitted with OCR and Sanskrit-English layer review debt. No clean critical-edition identity, cross-language equivalence, or complete surviving Kalhana corpus claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Manasollasa
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Unusually broad courtly governance and technical knowledge. Boundary: Five-book Sanskrit court encyclopedia; translations/excerpts separate.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Roster registration only; no body is admitted. Candidate research ceiling: principal-work. Principal unresolved gap: Exact digital Sanskrit edition and complete lawful English.

unresolved_authorities.title: Lilavati; Bijaganita
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Major South Asian mathematical transmission. Boundary: Lilavati and Bijaganita are distinct mathematical component works. One operator-permissioned mixed-author Colebrooke OCR body is admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: A mixed Brahmagupta-Bhaskara historical translation volume is admitted with OCR and component-boundary review debt. No complete Bhaskara work, Sanskrit body, or equivalence claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Khaza'in al-Futuh / Treasures of Victory
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Courtly conquest narrative and Indo-Persian political language. Boundary: Khaza'in al-Futuh only; poetic corpus separate.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: A complete named English translation edition is admitted with needs-review OCR debt. No Persian body, English-Persian equivalence, or complete Amir Khusrau corpus claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Nihon Shoki
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: Foundational Japanese court historiography. Boundary: Thirty-scroll court chronicle; manuscript and printed recensions separate. Two operator-permissioned Aston OCR volumes are admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Both Aston English volumes are admitted with OCR review debt. No Japanese witness, recension equivalence, or complete textual-tradition claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Tale of the Heike
unresolved_authorities.notes: Selected for the Medieval full roster: War memory transmitted between performance and manuscript traditions. Boundary: Multiple recensions and oral-performance lineage; no single original text. One operator-permissioned Sadler OCR body is admitted with review debt.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: A Sadler English OCR candidate is admitted with scan and recension review debt. No Japanese witness, complete-work, or performance-tradition completeness claim.

unresolved_authorities.title: Itinerarium / Relatio
unresolved_authorities.notes: Eyewitness account of Mongol court life, Eurasian geography, diplomacy, and interreligious encounter from the 1253–1255 mission. The private Michel–Wright Latin draft remains structurally cleaned but lexically unverified and is not admitted; the Rockhill English body also remains provisional.
unresolved_authorities.coverage_notes: Scoped to Rubruck's Itinerarium or Relatio. No body is admitted. The 1839 Latin edition and later English translations are distinct edition witnesses and do not establish complete-surviving-corpus coverage or cross-edition equivalence.
